 "topology": "6T CMOS Schmitt trigger (inverting core) + output inverter",
 "rationale": "Feedback NMOS (β3≈3β1) pushes vth_hi to ~1.3-1.42 V; feedback PMOS (β6≈2β5) pulls vth_lo to ~0.24-0.5 V. The worst-case hysteresis (ff/125C/1.98V) is ≈0.85 V. Long-L (2 µm) narrow stacks limit contention current to tens of µA during the threshold windows, so average power stays well below 64 µW. Static CMOS stages give rail-to-rail outputs. The output inverter makes the cell non-inverting."}

PARAMS = {
    "Ln":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),     # stack/feedback channel length (limits crowbar current)
    "Wn":   (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),    # input NMOS stack width (M1, M2)
    "r3":   (3.0, 1.5, 6.0),     # NMOS feedback strength beta3/beta1 -> sets vth_hi
    "Wp":   (1.5, 0.42, 4.0),    # input PMOS stack width (M4, M5)
    "r6":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),     # PMOS feedback strength beta6/beta5 -> sets vth_lo
    "Wo":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),    # output inverter NMOS width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = p["Ln"]; Wn = p["Wn"]; Wp = p["Wp"]
    W3 = p["r3"] * Wn
    W6 = p["r6"] * Wp
    Wo = p["Wo"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss")
    # NMOS pull-down stack: M1 (bottom), M2 (top); feedback M3 lifts node x
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)
    n.M("M2", "y", "vin", "x", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)
    n.M("M3", "vdd", "y", "x", "vss", "nfet", W3, L)
    # PMOS pull-up stack: M5 (top), M4 (bottom); feedback M6 pulls node z down
    n.M("M5", "z", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, L)
    n.M("M4", "y", "vin", "z", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, L)
    n.M("M6", "vss", "y", "z", "vdd", "pfet", W6, L)
    # Output inverter (core is inverting -> overall non-inverting), rail-to-rail
    n.M("M7", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wo, 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 3 * Wo, 0.15)

    # First-order square-law threshold estimates (TT, 1.8 V)
    vdd = 1.8; vtn = 0.62; vtp = 1.0
    k3 = math.sqrt(1.0 / p["r3"])
    vth_hi = (vdd + k3 * vtn) / (1 + k3)
    k6 = math.sqrt(1.0 / p["r6"])
    vth_lo = k6 * (vdd - vtp) / (1 + k6)

    # Crude crowbar estimate: peak ~ 0.5*kn'*(W/L)*(Vov)^2 with Vov~0.4, active ~40% of ramp
    kn = 250e-6
    ipk = 0.5 * kn * (Wn / L) * 0.4 ** 2
    power = vdd * ipk * 0.4 * 2
    return n, {"vth_hi": vth_hi, "vth_lo": vth_lo,
               "hysteresis": vth_hi - vth_lo, "power_avg": power}
